description: This PHP script handles updating relations between entities (vendors and other modules) within the vtiger CRM system. It processes request parameters to identify related entity IDs, determines the action to take, and calls functions to relate entities accordingly, then redirects to a detail or related list view.

classes.name: CRMEntity
classes.description: A class representing CRM entity objects, providing a method getInstance to obtain an entity object for a specific module.

methods.name: vtlib_purify
methods.description: Sanitizes input data to prevent security issues such as SQL injection.

methods.name: getParentTab
methods.description: Fetches the parent tab (top-level module or section) identifier used for navigation.

methods.name: CRMEntity::getInstance
methods.description: Creates or retrieves an instance of a CRM entity for the given module.

methods.name: relateEntities
methods.description: Establishes a relationship between two entities within the CRM system based on provided parameters.
